scope: Preserve genuine closed curves during noding, and collapse only curves whose entire control hull fits one graph vertex cell. Geometry, material, image, feature and editable export requirements are unchanged.

method.collapseCriterion: Every cubic control point has the same graph vertex key; convexity then bounds the whole curve to that cell.
method.closedCurves: Recursively split until endpoints have distinct graph keys. Retain small bridges across cell boundaries.
method.endpointNormalization: Existing adjacent-handle translation, now measured in graph metadata.
method.oracleWitness: Remap paths through retained/split edges, then independently check rendering, geometry and paper before solving.

limitations: Clean square gallery renderings only; no photograph crop or colour-classification evaluation.
Oracle variants expose exact visible geometry and the reference subdivision, including anchors a photograph may not reveal.
The compact graph is restricted to one known valid routing, not all valid template pairs. Missing reference edges do not prove that another routing is unavailable.
HiGHS is still given unknown sheet ownership; independent exported rendering and the normal geometry/paper checks remain required.
